context: Sho tells Yumiko about a school anime club.
purpose: Casual home register; vocabulary (小学校/出演/アニメ/バカ/嫌い) in natural home.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、小学校で劇に出演するんだ!
lines.en: Mom, I'm performing in a play at school!
lines.style: excited small child voice, bright warm bouncing delivery throughout

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: まあ、すごいわね。どんな役なの?
lines.style: gentle mother voice, soft warm caring delivery throughout

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: 好きなアニメの、主役なんだ!
lines.en: The lead of my favorite anime!
lines.style: thrilled small child voice, bright warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: セリフを、忘れないでね。
lines.style: warm mother voice, soft warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: 忘れたら、バカみたいだもん。
lines.en: If I forget, I'd look silly.
lines.style: worried small child voice, bright warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 練習が嫌いにならないようにね。
lines.en: Try not to come to dislike practice.
lines.style: gentle mother voice, soft warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: アニメの役だから、嫌いじゃないよ!
lines.en: It's an anime role, so I don't dislike it!
lines.style: cheerful small child voice, bright warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 小学校の劇、見に行くわね。
lines.en: I'll come watch the school play.
lines.style: tender mother voice, soft warm affectionate closing delivery throughout
